symptom: A dataview with `DataSource: selection dgItems` inside dgItems' own `controlbar {}` passed check; exec refused 'failed to build datasource: widget not found: dgItems'. Studio Pro and mxbuild accept the structure (measured 11.12.6: exec now writes it, mx check 0 errors, describe prints it back).
cause: A pluggable widget minted its ID and registered its name only after its slots (the control bar's widgets) were built, so a child listening to the containing grid found no such widget.
insight: **Register a container's name before building its children.** Native containers already did; the pluggable engine registered at Finalize. Safe to move because no caller retries a failed pluggable build, and the patch path's shadow build works on a cloned scope with the name deleted. The fixture matters: PedApp without its widgets/ cannot build a DataGrid2 at all (openPedAppWithWidgets).
